entries.label: brewers yeast
entries.description:
Brewing yeasts may be classed as "top-cropping" (or "top-fermenting") and "bottom-cropping" (or "bottom-fermenting"). Top-cropping yeasts are so called because they form a foam at the top of the wort during fermentation. An example of a top-cropping yeast is Saccharomyces cerevisiae, sometimes called an "ale yeast". Bottom-cropping yeasts are typically used to produce lager-type beers, though they can also produce ale-type beers. These yeasts ferment well at low temperatures. An example of bottom-cropping yeast is *Saccharomyces pastorianus*, formerly known as *Saccharomyces carlsbergensis*.
\n\n*Saccharomyces pastorianus* is a yeast used industrially for the production of lager beer, and is named after Louis Pasteur. It is a synonym of the yeast species *Saccharomyces carlsbergensis*,[ which was originally described in 1883 by Emil Christian Hansen, who was working for the Danish brewery Carlsberg.

Shorter or longer ripening phases combined with moisture reduction (drying) are necessary to build-up the typical flavour and texture of the final product. The acid gives filmjölk a sour taste and causes proteins in the milk, mainly casein, to coagulate, thus thickening the final product. The bacteria also produce a limited amount of diacetyl, which gives filmjölk its characteristic taste. Filmjölk is similar to cultured buttermilk, kefir, or yoghurt in consistency, but fermented by different bacteria and thus has a slightly different taste. Compared with yoghurt, filmjölk tastes less sour. entries.label: viili
entries.description: The group includes Viili (Finnish viili, Swedish fil), a type of yoghurt (a mesophilic fermented milk) that originated in the Nordic countries. It has a ropey, gelatinous consistency and a sour taste resulting from lactic acid. This cultured milk product is the results of microbial action of lactic acid bacteria (LAB) and a surface-growing yeast-like fungus Geotrichum candidum present in milk, which forms a velvet-like surface on viili. In addition, most traditional viili cultures also contain yeast strains such as Kluveromyces marxianus and Pichia fermentans. The LAB identified in viili including Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris, Lactococcus lactis subsp. lactis biovar. diacetylactis, Leuconostoc mesenteroides subsp. cremoris. Among those mesophilic LAB strains, the slime-forming Lc. lactis subsp. cremoris produce a phosphate-containing heteropolysaccharide, named viilian. The part consumed/analysed is by default the whole or a portion of it representing the observed heterogeneity.[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viili] and [https://www.google.co.uk/search?tbm=isch&q=Viili]

entries.label: yam bean
entries.description:
Pachyrhizus erosus, commonly known as jicama Mexican yam bean, or Mexican turnip, is the name of a native Mexican vine, although the name most commonly refers to the plant's edible tuberous root. Jícama is a species in the genus Pachyrhizus in the bean family (Fabaceae). Plants in this genus are commonly referred to as yam bean, although the term "yam bean" can be another name for jícama.

In contrast to the root, the remainder of the jícama plant is very poisonous; the seeds contain the toxin rotenone, which is used to poison insects and fish.

FAO: The yam bean is a legume but unlike its close relatives the soybean and other beans, the yam bean is cultivated for its large, tuberous roots.

entries.label: chicken stock
entries.description: Ready-to-use chicken-based cooking stock, commonly extracted from bones, meat and aromatics for body and flavor. Distinct from chicken broth and concentrated bouillon; salt and fat levels are unspecified.

entries.label: beef stock
entries.description: Ready-to-use beef-based cooking stock, commonly extracted from bones, meat and aromatics. Distinct from beef broth or bouillon concentrate; homemade wording alone does not prescribe salt or fat content.

entries.label: fish stock
entries.description: Ready-to-use fish-based stock for cooking, commonly extracted from fish bones, trimmings and aromatics. Distinct from fish broth, fish sauce and concentrated fish bouillon.

entries.label: lamb stock
entries.description: Ready-to-use cooking stock made from lamb bones or meat and aromatics; distinct from generic meat stock and from concentrated stock products.

entries.label: vegetable broth
entries.description: Ready-to-use vegetable-based broth. Retains the recipe's broth product type separately from vegetable stock; vegetable blends, salt levels and commercial stock/broth naming vary.

entries.label: low-sodium chicken broth
entries.description: Chicken broth specifically described as low-sodium or low-salt. This is not a claim of no sodium, no added salt, reduced sodium relative to another product, or a fat-free formulation.

entries.label: reduced-sodium chicken broth
entries.description: Chicken broth with sodium reduced relative to a reference formulation. A comparative reduction does not establish a low-sodium or unsalted product.

entries.label: fat-free chicken broth
entries.description: Chicken broth sold or specified as fat-free; retain that formulation separately from ordinary broth and from merely skimming fat off a broth.

entries.label: fat-free reduced-sodium chicken broth
aliases: fat free reduced sodium chicken broth
reduced sodium fat free chicken broth
fat free less sodium chicken broth
entries.description: Chicken broth with both fat-free and reduced-sodium claims. Neither claim by itself establishes the other or an unsalted broth.

entries.label: fat-skimmed chicken broth
entries.description: Chicken broth from which separable surface fat has been skimmed. Skimming does not establish a regulatory fat-free claim or a sodium level.

entries.label: canned beef broth
entries.description: Beef broth preserved by canning, ready for use as a cooking liquid. Distinct from a dry mix, concentrate or a stock; salt and fat levels are unspecified.

entries.label: canned low-sodium chicken broth
entries.description: Canned chicken broth with a low-sodium formulation; retains both preservation form and the low-sodium claim.

entries.label: low-sodium chicken stock
entries.description: Ready-to-use chicken stock with a low-sodium formulation. Distinct from chicken broth, concentrate and an unsalted or merely reduced-sodium stock.

entries.label: low-sodium vegetable broth
entries.description: Ready-to-use vegetable broth with a low-sodium formulation; distinct from ordinary vegetable stock and from unsalted or reduced-sodium products.

entries.label: single cream
entries.description: Single cream in the British cooking sense, typically around 18% milk fat. A pouring/cooking cream that does not perform like whipping, heavy or double cream; regional labeling can differ.

entries.label: double cream
entries.description: Double cream in the British cooking sense, with at least 48% milk fat. Richer than US heavy cream; retain the named type for texture, whipping and cooking behavior.

entries.label: whipping cream
entries.description: Unwhipped dairy cream intended to whip. The name alone leaves region and fat percentage unspecified; it does not select US light whipping cream, US heavy cream or British double cream.

entries.label: nonfat sour cream
entries.description: Sour cream with a nonfat formulation, distinct from ordinary or merely reduced-fat sour cream. Thickening and cooking behavior can differ.

entries.label: full-fat sour cream
entries.description: Sour cream explicitly specified as full-fat; retain the formulation rather than infer it from an unspecified sour cream entry.

entries.label: full-fat yogurt
entries.description: Yogurt explicitly specified as full-fat or whole-milk yogurt; different from nonfat and reduced-fat formulations. Sweetening and straining are unspecified.

entries.label: nonfat cream cheese
entries.description: Cream cheese with a nonfat/fat-free formulation; retains its different fat and moisture behavior from ordinary cream cheese.

entries.label: nonfat ricotta cheese
entries.description: Ricotta-style cheese with a nonfat formulation; distinct from whole-milk and part-skim ricotta.

entries.label: light coconut milk
entries.description: Reduced-fat coconut milk sold as light coconut milk. Distinct from full-fat coconut milk, coconut cream and ready-to-drink coconut beverages.

entries.label: light margarine
entries.description: Reduced-fat margarine spread; its higher water/lower fat formulation can change baking and cooking compared with ordinary margarine.

entries.label: unsalted margarine
entries.description: Margarine explicitly made without added salt; retains the seasoning distinction from unspecified or salted margarine.

entries.label: sweetened quark
entries.description: Quark with added sweetening, used as a dessert or baking component; retain the sweetening difference from plain quark.

entries.label: creamed horseradish
entries.description: Horseradish condiment prepared with dairy cream or a creamy base. Distinct from grated horseradish preserved simply with vinegar and salt; product formulations vary.

entries.label: basmati rice
entries.description: Aromatic long-grain rice of the basmati variety group. Preserve its named aroma, grain and cooking behavior separately from generic aromatic or long-grain rice.

entries.label: jasmine rice
entries.description: Aromatic long-grain rice of the jasmine variety group. Distinct from basmati and generic long-grain rice in aroma and cooked texture.

entries.label: rice for sushi
entries.description: Uncooked short- or medium-grain rice sold for sushi preparation. Distinct from cooked vinegar-seasoned sushi rice (sumeshi); the exact cultivar is unspecified.

entries.label: rice for paella
entries.description: Uncooked rice selected and sold for paella, a cooking-use group with suitable absorption and grain behavior. No specific Bomba, Calasparra or Valencia cultivar is inferred.

entries.label: Valencia rice
entries.description: Rice sold as Valencia rice for Spanish-style cooking; preserve the named rice type separately from generic rice and other paella rice varieties.

entries.label: lasagne pasta sheets
entries.description: Plain wide flat pasta sheets for lasagne, before cooking or assembly into a dish. Distinct from a prepared lasagne meal.

entries.label: cooked lasagne pasta sheets
entries.description: Lasagne pasta sheets after cooking and draining, before assembly into a dish. Distinct from uncooked sheets in hydration, weight and cooking instructions.

entries.label: rigatoni
entries.description: Short wide ridged tube-shaped pasta called rigatoni; preserve the named shape for cooking time and sauce handling.

entries.label: paccheri
entries.description: Large broad tube-shaped pasta called paccheri, distinct from smaller tube shapes such as rigatoni.

entries.label: fettuccine
entries.description: Flat ribbon-shaped wheat pasta called fettuccine. Exact egg content and fresh/dried form are unspecified; do not equate with a finished pasta dish.

entries.label: orzo pasta
entries.description: Small rice-shaped wheat pasta called orzo or risoni; distinct from rice grains and barley.

entries.label: udon noodles
entries.description: Thick Japanese wheat noodles called udon. Dry, fresh or precooked storage form is unspecified; distinct from soba and generic noodles.

entries.label: rice vermicelli
entries.description: Very thin rice noodles; distinct from wheat vermicelli and wider rice-noodle forms.

entries.label: flat rice noodles
entries.description: Flat ribbon-shaped rice noodles; width is unspecified. Distinct from round rice vermicelli.

entries.label: wide rice noodles
entries.description: Wide flat rice noodles; retain the width distinction from rice vermicelli and narrow flat rice noodles.

entries.label: brown rice noodles
entries.description: Noodles made from brown rice, retaining the whole-grain base separately from generic white-rice noodles.

entries.label: fresh angel hair pasta
entries.description: Fresh fine-strand wheat pasta of the angel-hair/capellini shape. Distinct from generic pasta and dried pasta cooking behavior.

entries.label: corn tortillas
entries.description: Tortillas made with a corn/maize base; distinct from wheat-flour tortillas. Storage and heating form are unspecified.

entries.label: wheat flour tortillas
entries.description: Soft tortillas made with wheat flour; distinct from corn tortillas. Portion diameter is recipe wording, not a separate ingredient identity.

entries.label: tostada shells
entries.description: Flat crisp corn-tortilla shells prepared for tostadas, distinct from soft tortillas and bowl-shaped taco shells.

entries.label: rice paper wrappers
entries.description: Thin edible rice-based wrappers for rolls, commonly sold as dried sheets that are hydrated before use. Some products also contain tapioca starch; formulation is not asserted by the name.

entries.label: whole-wheat couscous
entries.description: Couscous made from whole-wheat semolina, distinct from refined-wheat couscous.

entries.label: rum
entries.description: Distilled spirit made from sugarcane products, commonly molasses or cane juice. Generic rum does not specify color, aging, proof or regional style.

entries.label: dark rum
entries.description: Rum sold as dark rum, retaining its darker, richer style separately from white rum. Color alone does not establish age, proof or absence of added coloring.

entries.label: white rum
entries.description: Rum sold as white or light rum; a clear/light-colored style distinct from dark rum. Exact aging and proof are unspecified.

entries.label: Jamaican rum
entries.description: Rum identified as Jamaican in origin or style; color, aging and strength remain unspecified. Preserve the named regional spirit rather than alias all rum to it.

entries.label: cachaça
entries.description: Brazilian sugarcane-juice spirit called cachaça, distinct from generic molasses rum. Aging and strength are unspecified.

entries.label: amaretto
entries.description: Sweet almond-flavored Italian-style liqueur; ingredients can include apricot kernels or almonds. Distinct from almond extract and nonalcoholic flavoring.

entries.label: dashi
entries.description: Japanese cooking stock, commonly based on kombu, dried fish or other umami ingredients. The name alone does not establish the specific blend, allergens or instant versus homemade formulation.

entries.label: ginger paste
entries.description: Ginger processed into a paste for cooking. Additional oil, water, salt or preservatives depend on the product; distinct from raw whole ginger and ginger-garlic paste.

entries.label: ginger-garlic paste
entries.description: Prepared paste combining ginger and garlic for cooking. Proportions and additional ingredients are unspecified; distinct from either paste alone.

entries.label: rose water
entries.description: Food-grade rose distillate used as a floral flavoring; distinct from rose extract, syrup or cosmetic rose water.

entries.label: vanilla bean paste
entries.description: Prepared vanilla flavoring paste, commonly combining vanilla extract, seeds and a thickened/sweetened base. Distinct from whole beans and liquid extract.

entries.label: lemon extract
entries.description: Concentrated food-grade lemon flavoring extract; distinct from lemon juice, zest and essential oil intended for other uses.

entries.label: champagne vinegar
entries.description: Wine vinegar sold as Champagne vinegar; distinct from sparkling wine and generic white wine vinegar as a named culinary vinegar type.

entries.label: Sirop de Liège
entries.description: Concentrated Belgian fruit spread/syrup traditionally made by reducing pear and apple juices, sometimes with dates. Distinct from generic liquid fruit syrup.

entries.label: biryani masala
entries.description: Spice blend intended for biryani; recipes vary. Distinct from generic garam masala and from the completed rice dish.

entries.label: gingerbread spice blend
entries.description: Sweet baking spice blend for gingerbread, commonly featuring ginger with other warm spices. Exact composition varies.

entries.label: furikake
entries.description: Japanese dry rice-seasoning mixture, commonly including sesame and seaweed; fish, egg and other components vary. Do not infer a specific allergen-free formulation.

entries.label: oxtail
entries.description: Cattle tail cut for cooking, containing meat, connective tissue and bone. Distinct from generic beef and from prepared oxtail soup.

entries.label: lamb leg
entries.description: Lamb leg cut with bone status unspecified. Distinct from the existing specifically boneless leg and from a cooked lamb dish.

entries.label: lamb shoulder
entries.description: Lamb shoulder cut with bone status unspecified. Distinct from a shoulder blade chop, loin chop and leg cut.

entries.label: lamb shank
entries.description: Lower leg/shank cut of lamb, commonly bone-in and rich in connective tissue. Distinct from a whole leg of lamb.

entries.label: lamb loin chop
entries.description: Chop cut from the lamb loin; preserve the cut separately from generic lamb chops and shoulder chops.

entries.label: duck leg
entries.description: Duck leg cut; preservation, cooking and skin/bone status are unspecified. Distinct from generic duck meat and duck breast.

entries.label: boneless pork shoulder
entries.description: Pork shoulder cut with bones removed; distinct from bone-in or bone-unspecified pork shoulder.

entries.label: boneless pork loin
entries.description: Pork loin with bones removed; distinct from generic pork loin, shoulder and tenderloin.

entries.label: pork back ribs
entries.description: Pork ribs from the back/loin section, distinct from spareribs and generic pork ribs.

entries.label: pork loin chop
entries.description: Chop cut from the pork loin; preserve the named cut separately from generic pork chops.

entries.label: pork shoulder steak
entries.description: Steak cut from the pork shoulder; distinct from a loin chop and a whole shoulder roast.

entries.label: pork cutlet
entries.description: Thin pork cutlet for cooking; cut, breading and preparation are not otherwise specified. Distinct from generic pork meat.

entries.label: beef cutlet
entries.description: Thin beef cutlet for cooking; exact anatomical cut and preparation are unspecified. Distinct from generic beef and fabricated beef products.

entries.label: beef stew meat
entries.description: Beef sold or cut as stew meat, usually from connective-tissue-rich cuts for slow moist cooking. Exact anatomical cut is unspecified.

entries.label: beef chuck roast
entries.description: Roasting/braising cut from the beef chuck; distinct from generic chuck trimmings and other roast cuts.

entries.label: beef hanger steak
entries.description: Beef steak from the hanging tender/diaphragm area, distinct from generic beef and flank or skirt steak.

entries.label: flanken-cut beef short ribs
entries.description: Beef short ribs sliced across the rib bones in the flanken style; distinct from longer English-cut ribs in cooking behavior.

entries.label: boneless beef short ribs
entries.description: Beef short-rib meat with bones removed; distinct from bone-in short ribs and generic beef stew meat.

entries.label: boneless chicken breast
entries.description: Chicken breast with bones removed; skin status is unspecified. Distinct from the specifically skinless-and-boneless breast.

entries.label: boneless chicken thigh
entries.description: Chicken thigh with bones removed; skin status is unspecified. Distinct from a specifically skinless-and-boneless thigh.

entries.label: chicken cutlet
entries.description: Thin boneless chicken cutlet, commonly sliced from breast meat. Breading and cooking are unspecified; distinct from generic chicken meat.

entries.label: chicken wing drumette
entries.description: Upper fleshy segment of a chicken wing, distinct from the whole wing, wing flat and leg drumstick.

entries.label: ground chicken
entries.description: Chicken meat minced/ground for cooking; fat level and meat/skin composition are unspecified. Distinct from intact chicken cuts.

entries.label: cooked chicken
entries.description: Chicken meat after cooking, with cut and cooking method unspecified. Distinct from raw chicken in hydration, handling and recipe cooking requirements.

entries.label: cooked chicken breast
entries.description: Chicken breast after cooking; cooking method and bone/skin status are unspecified.

entries.label: cooked beef brisket
entries.description: Beef brisket after cooking; seasoning, curing and cooking method are unspecified. Distinct from raw brisket.

entries.label: cooked shrimp
entries.description: Shrimp after cooking; species, size, shell state and storage form are unspecified. Distinct from raw shrimp.

entries.label: boneless salmon fillet
entries.description: Salmon fillet specifically prepared without bones; species, skin and cooking state are unspecified.

entries.label: catfish fillet
entries.description: Catfish fillet with storage/cooking state unspecified; distinct from specifically frozen fillets and whole fish.

entries.label: skinless haddock fillet
entries.description: Haddock fillet with skin removed, without an assertion of frozen storage. Distinct from the existing specifically frozen skinless product.

entries.label: veal chop
entries.description: Chop cut of veal; exact rib/loin position and preparation are unspecified. Distinct from generic veal meat.

entries.label: flat-leaf parsley
entries.description: Leaves of flat-leaf/Italian parsley, distinct from curly-leaf parsley as a named culinary type.

entries.label: coriander stems
entries.description: Tender stems of coriander/cilantro used as an herb ingredient; distinct from leaves and coriander seeds.

entries.label: scallion greens
entries.description: Green leaf portion of scallions/spring onions, distinct from the white bulb/base or whole scallions.

entries.label: baby bok choy
entries.description: Small/tender bok choy sold as baby bok choy for cooking; exact cultivar is unspecified. Preserve the named produce type rather than infer a mature rosette.

entries.label: English cucumber
entries.description: Long, usually thin-skinned cucumber sold as English cucumber; distinct from small pickling and Persian types.

entries.label: Persian cucumber
entries.description: Small thin-skinned cucumber sold as Persian cucumber, distinct from long English and pickling types.

entries.label: Kirby cucumber
entries.description: Small firm pickling cucumber sold as Kirby, distinct from long slicing cucumbers.

entries.label: Japanese cucumber
entries.description: Slender cucumber sold as a Japanese cucumber type; distinct from generic cucumber and other named culinary types.

entries.label: seedless cucumber
entries.description: Cucumber sold as seedless, without inferring an English, Persian or other cultivar. Distinct from a generic cucumber's unspecified seed characteristic.

entries.label: Chinese eggplant
entries.description: Long slender eggplant sold as Chinese eggplant; preserve the culinary type separately from globose Italian and generic eggplant.

entries.label: Italian eggplant
entries.description: Eggplant sold as an Italian/globe type, distinct from slender Chinese/Japanese culinary types.

entries.label: green papaya
entries.description: Unripe papaya used as a firm vegetable, distinct from ripe sweet papaya fruit.

entries.label: Meyer lemon
entries.description: Fruit of the Meyer lemon type, with a distinct aroma and acidity from ordinary lemons.

entries.label: Bramley apple
entries.description: Bramley cooking apple, retaining the named tart cooking variety and its breakdown during cooking.

entries.label: Hass avocado
entries.description: Avocado of the Hass cultivar; preserve the named cultivar separately from generic avocado.

entries.label: Charlotte potato
entries.description: Charlotte potato variety, commonly a firm/waxy salad potato; distinct from generic potatoes and floury cooking types.

entries.label: Jersey Royal potato
entries.description: Potato sold as Jersey Royal, a named small/new potato product; distinct from generic potato and other named varieties.

entries.label: floury potato
entries.description: Potato selected for a floury/high-starch cooking texture, without assigning a specific cultivar. Distinct from waxy potatoes.

entries.label: hispi cabbage
entries.description: Pointed sweetheart/hispi cabbage used for cooking; retain the named tender cabbage type.

entries.label: purple sprouting broccoli
entries.description: Broccoli type harvested for slender purple flowering shoots; distinct from a standard broccoli head.

entries.label: Red Russian kale
entries.description: Red Russian kale type, with its named tender leaf characteristics; distinct from generic curly kale.

entries.label: white yam
entries.description: Edible yam sold as white yam, commonly Dioscorea rotundata. Exact species must be confirmed when required; distinct from sweet potato and unspecified yam.

entries.label: banana leaf
entries.description: Banana leaf used for wrapping, steaming or serving food; distinct from banana fruit. It is generally a cooking wrapper rather than an eaten fruit ingredient.

entries.label: dark brown sugar
entries.description: Moist brown sugar with a darker/higher-molasses style than light brown sugar; preserve the named sweetness, moisture and flavor distinction.

entries.label: golden caster sugar
entries.description: Fine-grained golden caster sugar, retaining its light molasses/cane flavor separately from ordinary white caster sugar.

entries.label: dark muscovado sugar
entries.description: Dark muscovado sugar, a strongly molasses-flavored moist unrefined/partly refined cane sugar. Distinct from light muscovado and generic brown sugar.

entries.label: light corn syrup
entries.description: Light-colored corn syrup for baking/confectionery; distinct from dark corn syrup and high-fructose beverage syrup.

entries.label: dry white wine
entries.description: White wine explicitly specified as dry, retaining the low residual sweetness style separately from generic or sweet white wine.

entries.label: dry red wine
entries.description: Red wine explicitly specified as dry; retains the sweetness style separately from unspecified red wine.

entries.label: sweet white wine
entries.description: White wine explicitly specified as sweet; exact grape, sweetness level and fortification are unspecified.

entries.label: dry sherry
entries.description: Sherry specified as a dry style, distinct from sweet or cream sherry. Exact sherry subtype is unspecified.

entries.label: sweet sherry
entries.description: Sherry specified as sweet, without selecting a particular cream, Pedro Ximénez or other subtype.

entries.label: brown ale
entries.description: Ale of the brown-ale style, retaining its malt/roast character separately from generic ale.

entries.label: Irish cream liqueur
entries.description: Cream liqueur of the Irish-cream type, combining dairy cream with spirits and flavorings. Distinct from generic cream liqueur or unalcoholic dairy cream.

entries.label: toasted sesame oil
entries.description: Aromatic oil pressed from toasted/roasted sesame seeds, distinct from mild untoasted sesame oil.

entries.label: crushed tomatoes
entries.description: Tomatoes processed into crushed pieces with juice/puree for cooking, commonly canned. Distinct from whole fresh tomatoes, smooth puree and paste; packaging is unspecified.

entries.label: roasted bell pepper
entries.description: Bell pepper after roasting, with color and preservation unspecified; distinct from raw peppers.

entries.label: roasted red bell pepper
entries.description: Red bell pepper after roasting; brining, oil packing and packaging are unspecified.

entries.label: stewed tomatoes
entries.description: Tomatoes cooked/stewed as a cooking ingredient, often with seasoning; distinct from plain canned whole or diced tomatoes.

entries.label: poblano pepper
entries.description: Fresh poblano chili pepper, distinct from dried ancho pepper. The seed's ancho entry does not cover the fresh material.

entries.label: ground chipotle pepper
entries.description: Chipotle (smoke-dried jalapeño) ground into a powder; distinct from whole chipotles and chipotles canned in adobo.

entries.label: chipotle peppers in adobo
entries.description: Chipotle peppers preserved in adobo sauce as a prepared ingredient. Distinct from dry chipotle powder, plain dried chipotles or generic adobo sauce.

entries.description: Dry powdered vegetable stock base intended for reconstitution. Formula and salt level are unspecified; distinct from prepared liquid vegetable stock or broth.

entries.label: condensed French onion soup
entries.description: Concentrated prepared French-onion-style soup intended for dilution or cooking as a pantry component. Distinct from dry onion soup mix and generic condensed soup; brand/animal stock are unspecified.

entries.label: Irish whiskey
entries.description: Whiskey produced in the Irish style and identified as Irish whiskey. Distinct from other named whiskey styles; grain mix, age and brand are unspecified.

entries.label: kirsch
entries.description: Cherry eau-de-vie distilled from fermented cherries, commonly called kirsch or kirschwasser. Distinct from sweet cherry liqueur and cherry flavoring; age and alcohol percentage are unspecified.

entries.label: medium-dry sherry
entries.description: Sherry wine in the medium-dry sweetness style. Distinct from dry, medium-sweet, cream and sweet sherry; exact sugar content and brand are unspecified.

entries.label: orange liqueur
entries.description: Orange-flavored liqueur with style, spirit base, color and sweetness unspecified. Not automatically triple sec, curacao, orange juice or a named brand.

entries.label: ginger juice
entries.description: Juice expressed from ginger rhizome. Distinct from sweetened ginger cordial, ginger beer, ginger paste and whole ginger; concentration is unspecified.

entries.label: yuzu juice
entries.description: Juice of yuzu citrus fruit. Distinct from yuzu kosho, ponzu sauce and mixed citrus dressings; brand and concentration are unspecified.

entries.label: Braeburn apples
entries.description: Apple fruit of the Braeburn cultivar. Distinct from generic apples and other named cultivars; physical cutting and storage form are unspecified.

entries.label: Bermuda onions
entries.description: Onion bulbs of the culinary Bermuda-onion cultivar group. Color and particular cultivar are unspecified; not automatically a red, white or yellow onion subtype.

entries.label: Anaheim peppers
entries.description: Culinary Anaheim-type chile pepper fruit. Color, heat, fresh/dried state and named strain are unspecified; distinct from generic chili pepper and other named chile types.

entries.label: arame seaweed
entries.description: Edible arame seaweed material from Eisenia bicyclis, also classified as Ecklonia bicyclis. Preparation is unspecified; commonly sold dried. Not kombu, hijiki or the algal taxon as a nonfood organism.

entries.label: Japanese eggplants
entries.description: Edible fruit of the long, slender Japanese eggplant culinary type, typically thin-skinned. Cultivar and processing are unspecified; not automatically globe, Chinese or Filipino eggplant.

entries.label: kabocha squash
entries.description: Edible fruit of the kabocha/Japanese winter-squash type. Variety, color and processing are unspecified; distinct from generic pumpkin, butternut squash and other winter-squash types.

entries.label: Kampot pepper
entries.description: Peppercorn material identified by the Kampot regional type. Color and processing remain unspecified; not automatically black, white, red or fresh green Kampot pepper.

entries.label: lemon cucumbers
entries.description: Edible lemon-shaped yellow cucumber fruit of the lemon-cucumber type. Distinct from lemons, generic cucumbers and other named cucumber types.

entries.label: golden beets
entries.description: Golden/yellow-fleshed table beet roots. Distinct from red table beets, sugar beet and beet leaves; cooking/preservation are unspecified.

entries.label: green garlic
entries.description: Immature garlic harvested before fully mature bulbs develop, used as a culinary plant material. Distinct from mature garlic cloves, garlic scapes and green garlic powder.

entries.label: árbol peppers
entries.description: Culinary chile de arbol pepper fruit; fresh/dried state is unspecified. Distinct from ground arbol powder and other chile types; named strain is unspecified.

entries.label: lime peel
entries.description: Outer peel/rind of lime, without assuming removal of all white pith. Distinct from the specifically colored outer lime zest, lime flesh and lime juice.

entries.label: dried cherries
entries.description: Cherry fruit preserved by conventional drying/dehydration. Sweet/sour variety and added sweetener are unspecified; distinct from fresh, frozen and candied cherries.

entries.label: dried cranberries
entries.description: Cranberry fruit preserved by drying/dehydration; added sugar is unspecified. Distinct from fresh cranberries and dried cranberry beans; use a qualified form when sweetening is specified.

entries.label: dried strawberries
entries.description: Strawberry fruit preserved by conventional drying/dehydration, with added sweetener unspecified. Distinct from fresh/frozen fruit and the separate freeze-dried strawberry form.

entries.label: dried tart cherries
entries.description: Sour/tart cherry fruit preserved by drying. Added sweetener and cultivar are unspecified; distinct from generic dried cherries and fresh sour cherries.

entries.label: roasted chestnuts
entries.description: Chestnuts after roasting; species, salt and peeling are unspecified. Distinct from raw, canned and boiled/steamed chestnuts.

entries.label: cooked chestnuts
entries.description: Chestnuts after cooking with the cooking method unspecified. Does not force roasted, canned or sweetened forms; distinct from uncooked chestnuts.

entries.label: roasted pistachios
entries.description: Pistachio kernels/nuts after roasting. Shell, oil/dry-roasting process and added salt are unspecified; not raw pistachios or a specifically salted product.

entries.label: frozen banana
entries.description: Banana fruit preserved by freezing. Cultivar, ripeness and physical cutting are unspecified; distinct from fresh, dried and cooked banana.

entries.label: frozen banana leaves
entries.description: Banana plant leaves preserved by freezing for cooking/wrapping uses. Distinct from banana fruit, fresh leaves and dried wrapping leaves.

entries.label: frozen okra
entries.description: Okra pods preserved by freezing; physical cutting is unspecified. Represents the unprepared frozen vegetable, distinct from fresh okra or cooked/fried products.

entries.label: frozen shelled edamame
entries.description: Immature soybean seeds removed from their pods and preserved by freezing. Cooking/blanching status is unspecified; not whole edamame pods or mature dried soybeans.

entries.label: pickled beets
entries.description: Table beet roots preserved by pickling, with canning/container type unspecified. Distinct from raw beets and the specifically canned pickled-beet identity.

entries.label: brine-cured black olives
entries.description: Black olives cured in brine; variety, pitting and packing container are unspecified. Distinct from oil-cured black olives and generic olives in brine without color specified.

entries.label: peaches in syrup
entries.description: Peach fruit packed/preserved in syrup. Variety, cut, syrup concentration and container are unspecified; not necessarily freestone peach halves in light syrup.

entries.label: reduced-sodium black beans
entries.description: Black turtle beans in a reduced-sodium prepared/packaged formulation relative to a reference product. Not an absolute low-sodium or no-added-salt claim; container is unspecified.

entries.label: fat-free refried beans
entries.description: Refried beans prepared as a fat-free formulation. Bean variety and brand are unspecified; distinct from ordinary refried beans containing added fat.

entries.label: whole chicken
entries.description: A whole dressed raw chicken for cooking, retaining bones. Skin, separately packed giblets/neck and bird age are unspecified; not just chicken meat or a cooked bird.

entries.label: whole broiler chicken
entries.description: A whole dressed raw young broiler/fryer chicken for cooking, rather than only its meat. Distinct from a mature stewing hen and from unspecified-age chicken meat.

entries.label: stewing hen
entries.description: A mature hen intended for long moist cooking, as a dressed bird with bones rather than only meat. Distinct from young broiler/fryer chicken; breed and giblet packing are unspecified.

entries.label: beef sirloin
entries.description: Raw beef from the sirloin anatomical cut, with portioning and bone status unspecified. Not restricted to sirloin steaks or ground sirloin.

entries.label: boneless beef chuck roast
entries.description: A raw beef chuck cut sold as a roast with bones removed. Distinct from generic chuck, unspecified-bone chuck roast and cooked roast beef.

entries.label: ground veal
entries.description: Veal meat processed by grinding/mincing, rather than an intact cut. Fat content and cooking are unspecified; not ground adult beef.

entries.label: ground turkey breast
entries.description: Ground/minced turkey breast meat. Skin and exact fat content are unspecified; not assumed equivalent to mixed-cut ground turkey or a lean/fat-free claim.

entries.label: lean ground turkey
entries.description: Ground turkey identified as a lean formulation. Exact fat percentage and meat-cut composition are unspecified; not automatically breast-only, extra-lean or fat-free turkey.

entries.label: lamb steaks
entries.description: Raw lamb portions sold as steaks. Anatomical cut and bone status are unspecified; distinct from cooked steak and from stew-meat preparation.

entries.label: lamb stew meat
entries.description: Raw lamb meat cut/selected for stewing. Anatomical cut and bone status are unspecified; not already cooked stew or ground lamb.

entries.label: pork leg
entries.description: Raw pork leg/ham cut with bone and portioning unspecified. Distinct from cured ham and from the narrower leg-cap steak form.

entries.label: confit duck leg
entries.description: Duck leg preserved/prepared by slow cooking in fat as confit. Brand, salt and packing are unspecified; not a raw duck leg or whole duck.

entries.label: hot-smoked salmon
entries.description: Salmon processed by hot smoking, with a cooked texture. Cut/physical flaking and species are unspecified; distinct from cold-smoked salmon and unspecified hard/dried smoking styles.

entries.label: imitation crabmeat
entries.description: Crab-style seafood analogue made from formulated/flavored fish surimi, sold in sticks/flakes or similar pieces. Shape and ingredients are unspecified; not plain surimi or actual crab meat.

entries.label: chunk light tuna in water
aliases: chunk light tuna packed in water
entries.description: Ready-to-use chunk-style light-meat tuna packed in water. Can/pouch packing and salt level are unspecified; distinct from solid-pack tuna, white tuna and oil-packed forms.

entries.label: salmon caviar
entries.description: Salmon roe prepared/cured with salt for use as a caviar-style product. Species, packing and added seasonings are unspecified; not raw salmon roe or sturgeon caviar.

entries.label: shrimp heads
entries.description: Heads of culinary shrimp, used as a separate cooking material, for example to flavor stock. Species and preservation are unspecified; not shrimp tails/meat or shell-only material.

entries.label: ground annatto seed
entries.description: Annatto/achiote seed processed into a ground powder. Distinct from whole annatto seed, achiote seasoning paste and mixed recado-style seasonings.

entries.label: dried red chili peppers
entries.description: Red chile pepper fruit preserved by drying. Variety, heat and physical cutting are unspecified; not fresh red chilies, ground powder or unspecified-color dried chilies.

entries.label: dried summer savory leaves
entries.description: Leaves of summer savory preserved by drying, with grinding not assumed. Distinct from ground generic savory, winter savory and fresh summer savory leaves.

entries.label: dried garlic flakes
entries.description: Garlic preserved by drying/dehydration in flake form. Distinct from fresh chopped garlic, garlic powder, granules and garlic salt.

entries.label: fried garlic
entries.description: Garlic prepared by frying, with oil, cut and subsequent drying unspecified. Distinct from fresh garlic, dried garlic and plain garlic oil.

entries.label: galangal paste
entries.description: A cooking paste based on galangal rhizome. Other ingredients are unspecified; distinct from fresh galangal, ginger paste and blended curry paste.

entries.label: taco seasoning mix
entries.description: Dry spice/seasoning blend intended for taco fillings. Exact herbs, salt, thickeners and proportions are unspecified; not taco sauce or a fixed commercial formula.

entries.label: fajita seasoning
entries.description: Dry spice/seasoning blend intended for fajitas. Exact salt, herbs and proportions are unspecified; not a completed fajita dish, marinade or a particular brand.

entries.label: speculaas spice mix
entries.description: Warm-spice blend for speculaas/speculoos-style baking, typically led by cinnamon. Exact spice recipe is unspecified; not the cookies, crumbs or cookie spread.

entries.label: sweet smoked paprika
entries.description: Paprika identified as both sweet/mild and smoked. Country and cultivar are unspecified; distinct from hot-smoked paprika and unsmoked sweet paprika.

entries.label: massaman curry paste
entries.description: Prepared aromatic spice paste for massaman-style curry. Exact ingredients and animal-derived additions are unspecified; not generic red/yellow curry paste or finished curry.

entries.label: tom yum paste
entries.description: Concentrated aromatic paste/base for tom yum-style soup. Exact ingredients, heat and animal-derived additions are unspecified; not prepared soup or another Thai curry paste.

entries.label: balsamic vinaigrette
entries.description: Vinaigrette dressing made with balsamic vinegar. Oil, sweetness and additions are unspecified; distinct from plain balsamic vinegar and generic vinaigrette.

entries.label: citrus vinaigrette
entries.description: Vinaigrette-style dressing containing citrus juice/flavor. Citrus species, oil and additions are unspecified; not plain citrus juice or generic vinaigrette.

entries.label: red enchilada sauce
entries.description: Prepared red-chile/tomato-style sauce for enchiladas. Exact recipe and heat are unspecified; distinct from green enchilada sauce, dry mix and generic enchilada sauce.

entries.label: low-sodium Worcestershire sauce
entries.description: Worcestershire-style sauce explicitly formulated/labeled low-sodium. Distinct from regular sauce and from a merely reduced-sodium claim; recipe and exact sodium are unspecified.

entries.label: low-fat Italian dressing
entries.description: Italian-style salad dressing in a low-fat formulation. Bottle/brand and exact fat level are unspecified; distinct from regular Italian dressing and unrelated low-fat dressings.

entries.label: light Alfredo sauce
entries.description: Alfredo-style sauce identified as a light formulation, reduced in fat and/or energy relative to its regular counterpart. Exact comparison is unspecified; not regular Alfredo sauce or a fixed fat percentage.

entries.label: canola mayonnaise
entries.description: Mayonnaise made with canola oil as its named oil formulation. Exact fat content and other ingredients are unspecified; distinct from mayonnaise with an unspecified/different oil base.

entries.label: fat-free mayonnaise
entries.description: Mayonnaise-style condiment formulated and identified as fat-free. Distinct from regular, light and low-fat mayonnaise; exact recipe and brand are unspecified.

entries.label: butter cooking spray
entries.description: Cooking spray formulated with butter and/or butter flavor. Base oil, propellant and dairy content are unspecified; not assumed equivalent to plain vegetable-oil spray or melted butter.

entries.label: brioche
entries.description: Baked brioche bread, an enriched yeast bread containing butter and eggs. Shape and sweetness are unspecified; distinct from unbaked brioche dough.

entries.label: muesli
entries.description: A dry muesli breakfast-cereal mixture based on rolled grains with variable fruit/nut/seed additions. Exact mix is unspecified; distinct from baked granola and a prepared soaked muesli dish.

entries.label: semisweet chocolate
entries.description: Chocolate in the semisweet baking/confectionery sweetness style. Cocoa percentage and physical shape are unspecified; distinct from unsweetened chocolate, semisweet chocolate chips and the bittersweet sweetness style.

entries.label: milk chocolate chips
entries.description: Milk-chocolate pieces manufactured in chip/drop form for baking. Exact formulation is unspecified; not semisweet/dark chips or a plain milk-chocolate bar.

entries.label: chocolate-covered English toffee
entries.description: English-style toffee confection coated with chocolate. Chocolate type and nut additions are unspecified; not plain toffee or uncoated chocolate.

entries.label: almond pastry filling
entries.description: Prepared sweet almond-based filling for baking/pastry. Other ingredients and proportions are unspecified; distinct from whole almonds, almond paste and marzipan.

entries.label: cream cheese frosting
entries.description: Sweet frosting/icing based on cream cheese. Sugar, butter and other proportions are unspecified; distinct from plain cream cheese and generic buttercream.

entries.label: butterscotch filling
entries.description: Prepared butterscotch-flavored filling for pies/pastry or similar cooking uses. Recipe is unspecified; distinct from dry pudding mix, candy and caramel sauce.

entries.label: caramel sauce
entries.description: Pourable dessert-style sauce based on caramelized sugar, with dairy and other additions unspecified. Distinct from chewy caramel candy and concentrated savory browning/coloring sauce.

entries.label: dark corn syrup
entries.description: Dark-style corn syrup with its characteristic darker color and flavor. Brand and precise formulation are unspecified; not light corn syrup, molasses or a claim of high-fructose corn syrup composition.

entries.label: red wine jelly
entries.description: Set sweet jelly prepared with red wine. Wine variety and remaining alcohol are unspecified; distinct from generic/white-wine jelly, grape jelly and liquid red wine.

entries.label: peanut brittle
entries.description: Brittle sugar confection containing peanuts. Recipe and other ingredients are unspecified; distinct from nut-unspecified brittle and other named nut brittles.

entries.label: peanut cookies
entries.description: Baked cookies characterized by peanuts, with peanut form and other ingredients unspecified. Not forced to the narrower peanut-butter-cookie formulation.

entries.label: pistachio paste
entries.description: Paste based on ground pistachio nuts, with roasting, sweetening and other additions unspecified. Distinct from whole nuts and a specifically pure or sweetened paste. Dairy and sugar content are unspecified.

entries.label: seasoned breadcrumbs
entries.description: Bread crumbs blended with seasonings for cooking. Recipe, salt, grain and crumb texture are unspecified; not plain breadcrumbs, panko or a particular Italian-style formula.

entries.label: self-rising cake flour
entries.description: Cake-type wheat flour premixed with chemical leavening as a self-rising product. Exact leavener/salt level is unspecified; distinct from plain cake flour and general self-rising flour.

entries.label: soft-wheat flour
entries.description: Flour milled from soft wheat, retaining that wheat/protein class. Refinement and whole-grain status are unspecified; not the grain itself or unspecified/hard bread flour.

entries.label: strong wholemeal wheat flour
entries.description: Wholemeal wheat flour identified as strong/bread-making flour. Exact protein level and additions are unspecified; distinct from generic wholemeal flour, refined bread flour and rye flour.

entries.label: white bread mix
entries.description: Prepared mix intended for white/refined-wheat bread. Included yeast, salt and other additions are unspecified; distinct from plain flour and wholemeal bread mix.

entries.label: prebaked pizza crust
entries.description: Pizza bread base that has been baked/set before use as a recipe component. Exact degree of baking, grain and thickness are unspecified; distinct from raw pizza dough.

entries.label: sesame hamburger buns
entries.description: Hamburger-style bread buns containing/topped with sesame seeds. Flour, egg/dairy and sweetness are unspecified; distinct from plain buns and loose sesame seeds.

entries.label: whole-wheat hamburger buns
entries.description: Hamburger-style bread buns made with whole-wheat flour. Recipe and size are unspecified; distinct from refined-wheat burger buns and an unportioned loaf.

entries.label: toffee-coated popcorn
entries.description: Popcorn coated with toffee-style confectionery. Exact recipe and additions are unspecified; distinct from plain popcorn and a caramel sauce or coating supplied separately.

entries.label: gelatin sheets
entries.description: Edible gelatin supplied as dried leaves/sheets for setting foods. Bloom strength and animal source are unspecified; distinct from powdered gelatin and prepared gelatin dessert.

entries.label: Dutch sugar syrup
entries.description: Pourable Dutch sugar syrup of the schenkstroop type. Distinct from thick apple/fruit stroop, golden syrup and prepared stroopwafel filling.

entries.label: caramel browning sauce
entries.description: Concentrated caramel-based browning/coloring sauce used in cooking and Caribbean-style baking. Brand/seasoning are unspecified; distinct from dessert caramel sauce and British brown table sauce.

entries.label: ginger cordial syrup
entries.description: Sweetened non-alcoholic ginger cordial concentrate for dilution/flavoring. Distinct from plain ginger juice, ginger beer and ginger liqueur.

entries.label: apricot liqueur
entries.description: Sweet apricot-flavored liqueur, sometimes marketed as apricot brandy. Distinct from dry distilled apricot eau-de-vie; brand and spirit base are unspecified.

entries.label: apricot eau-de-vie
entries.description: Dry distilled spirit from fermented apricots. Distinct from sweet apricot liqueur, brandy flavoring and grape brandy; exact strength and age are unspecified.

entries.label: reduced-sodium ham
entries.description: Ham formulated with less sodium than a reference counterpart. Exact reduction, reference product and processing are unspecified; not a low-sodium, unsalted or 33%-reduction guarantee.

entries.label: reduced-sodium taco seasoning mix
entries.description: Dry taco-seasoning blend with sodium reduced relative to a reference mix. Exact percentage and recipe are unspecified; not an absolute low-sodium or 40%-reduction claim.

entries.label: thin pizza crust dough
entries.description: Unbaked pizza dough formed or intended as a thin crust. Exact flour and thickness are unspecified; distinct from a prebaked thin pizza base.

entries.label: prebaked thin pizza crust
entries.description: Thin pizza bread base that has been baked/set before use. Exact grain and degree of baking are unspecified; distinct from raw thin pizza dough.

entries.label: pure pistachio paste
entries.description: Paste made entirely from pistachio nuts, without added sugar or dairy. Roast state is unspecified; distinct from a sweetened paste or pistachio cream spread.

entries.label: sweetened pistachio paste
entries.description: Pistachio-nut paste prepared with added sweetener. Exact ratio and other additions are unspecified; distinct from pure pistachio paste and unspecified-sweetening paste.

entries.label: dried arame seaweed
entries.description: Edible arame seaweed preserved by drying. Distinct from unspecified-state arame, kombu and hijiki; physical cutting and species within the arame name remain as defined for the material.

entries.label: sweetened dried cranberries
entries.description: Cranberry fruit preserved by drying with added sweetener. Sweetener and ratio are unspecified; distinct from unsweetened and unspecified-sweetening dried cranberries.

entries.label: green food coloring
entries.description: Edible food-coloring preparation identified as green. Dye system, concentration and liquid/gel/powder form are unspecified; not a named chemical or brand.

entries.label: red food coloring
entries.description: Edible food-coloring preparation identified as red. Dye system, concentration and liquid/gel/powder form are unspecified; not a named chemical or brand.

entries.label: reduced-sugar orange marmalade
entries.description: Orange marmalade formulated with less sugar than a reference counterpart. Exact reduction and alternative sweeteners are unspecified; distinct from regular marmalade and a mere reduced-energy claim.
